context.issue_title: Change audit_log.resource_id to TEXT - Integration Tests
context.background: The audit_log.resource_id column has been migrated from UUID to TEXT to support text-keyed resources (role_name, event_type, definition names). Integration tests must verify that both UUID-keyed resources (instances) and text-keyed resources (roles, event types) can be audited, persisted, and queried correctly.

task.description:
Write integration tests for ISS-103: audit_log.resource_id TEXT support

Acceptance criteria:
1. Integration test suite that audits UUID-keyed resources (instance changes) and verifies they are persisted and queryable
2. Integration test suite that audits text-keyed resources (role grants using role_name, event type changes) and verifies they are persisted and queryable
3. Both test suites verify that idx_audit_resource index works correctly for efficient lookups
4. Tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL
5. Tests use per-test UUIDs and clean up after themselves
6. All tests pass without skipping
acceptance_criteria: Integration test for UUID-keyed resource auditing passes
Integration test for text-keyed resource auditing passes
Both tests verify idx_audit_resource index enables efficient queries
Tests clean up their audit entries post-test
All tests execute against real PostgreSQL
